No.1950/2019, whereby cognizance of offences under sections 341, 323, 498A, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegation in order to coerce the husband into submission.
It is next submitted that petitioners are father-in-law, brother-in-law and sister-in-law (Nanad) of the O.P. No.2.

It is further submitted that petitioner no.4 is father-in-law of petitioner no.2 but still he has been roped by the O.P. No.2 in the present case.
